Our Dark Iron Castle and@the Grandred Fenossa@were goin' at it head-to-head.
Most of the legion's officers and grunts got wiped out,@we got flung off to some place we didn't know,@and got separated from Lord Dark Brain...

Wha--!?
Roa
What...!?
A space-time gate... You mean a Cross Gate?
Where was it?
Way, way far from here, floatin' in a sector@full of rocks. Looked like what was left@after a planet or somethin' got smashed.
Fairy
(Could it be... our planet...?!)
After that, we made space jump after space jump@in the Dark Iron Castle, chasin' after@Lord Dark Brain.
But the malfunctions slowed us down a ton.@By the time we finally made it to Earth's sphere,@you lot had already beaten His Lordship...
So we figured we'd get revenge,@and set about rebuildin' the legion.
First, we repaired the Dark Iron Castle that@the Grandred Fenossa trashed, and healed@our own wounds while we were at it.
Next, we built a base on the surface@and set about gettin' more minions.
That was my job~
A base on the surface...
You mean the pyramid on the ruins@of the <Garden of Baral>...?
Right about then, malice bodies showed up@on the surface.
While we were pokin' around, it came up that@they might be able to serve as a vessel@and power source for Lord Dark Brain.
So I gathered up the malice bodies,@cultivated them, and made them giant~
Then the Ares Geist is...!
It soaked up negative energy inside@the space-time gate and transformed~
Thanks to that, we can use it as a high-performance@converter and booster for malice bodies~
Then we have it absorb the energy given off@by the space-time gate, and pump out more@and more malice bodies~
Once they all clump together,@they'll be Lord Dark Brain's vessel~!
What about what goes inside it, huh?!
Where there is light, there is darkness...@Where there is intelligent life, there is malice~
Startin' with you lot, we'll slaughter every Earthling@and create a huge mass of negative thoughts~!
Once that dwells in the vessel,@Lord Dark Brain will descend upon us~!
But what about their true body, that collection@of ancient wisdom... What about the Kaimei Brain?
Pfft, buhuu! Gwahahaha!!
You really don't get it, do ya?
Don't get it...?@Ah, could it be...!
What're you gettin' at?
They have a substitute for the Kaimei Brain...!
...I imagine so.
What's that supposed to mean!?

Amala, your Galilnagant may@qualify as well.
...The ancient wisdom itself...@You mean the Fureim that dwells in@the Granteed Dracodeus?
Yes.
(If my guess is right...@the Granteed Dracodeus would make@for the finest material of all.)
With you here, the malice bodies will activate~!
You lot beat Lord Dark Brain,@and now you're gonna bring His Lordship back!

Miles

I believe that would be dangerous.
If the Ares Geist is destroyed in that position,@there's no telling what might happen.
Then what're we supposed to do?
We'll secure the Ares Geist ourselves@and pull it away from above the Cross Gate.
Arieil, this is your last chance.
Yes, I know!
Commander, we'll clear the enemies around the@Cross Gate and secure the Ares Geist. Is that all right?
Yes, that's fine.@We must never allow Dark Brain to be revived.
Sir!
Debu, you focus on the spell.@I'll take care of that bunch.
Okaaay~

All units, commence attack!
Eita

Kuro

From the other side... it's coming!
What is that?!
A fortress... No, a battleship?
To think that ship would appear here...!
You know that thing?!
Yes...
N-No way!@That idiot came outta the space-time gate...!

Then it's on Shoko and the others' side...
Kyaaah!!
Hey! It's shootin' at us!!
Ngh! Why are you attacking us?!
The deity ship's mission is the annihilation@of aggregates of negative thought...
That thing just talked!
Roa, didn't you say the Grandred Fenossa@had no will of its own?
Where there is light, there is darkness. Where there@is good, there is evil. Where there is life-thought,@there is malice.
Light and darkness, good and evil, life-thought@and malice... Their struggle repeats for all eternity.
Its foremost cause is intelligent life...@those to whom my clan once granted wisdom.
H-Hey, Shu!@What that thing's sayin', it's just like...!
...Yes, it resembles him.
When the deity ship fell into the space-time gate@during the struggle with the Kaimei Brain's servants...
I awakened and regained my true form and power.
Th-That's...!
That ring of light...!!
It can't be?!
Behold, my machine-god body...
Shu, that halo coming from its head...!
It resembles Kadum Hakam's.
The king of the giants who appeared in La Gias?
Yes...@He tried to carry out a purge in that land@under the name of enlightenment.
What's the deal, Roa?!
...I don't know. I've never seen that form before.
The Grandred Fenossa is already@under my control.
Are you Kadum Hakam?
Yes... And to fulfill my mission,@I changed my very nature.
XN-L
My new name is XN-L.
(It can't be...?!)
You fought Dark Brain alongside Roa and the rest!@So why the heck are you attackin' us?!
...Long ago, after granting wisdom to the ancients,@I sealed myself in this machine-god body and fell@into a long sleep to prepare for a great trial.
Just like the creator god Fureim...!
And time passed... The ancients' descendants@unearthed me and built me into@the Grandred Fenossa.
So you were used as a weapon@against your will?
Yes... That is the sin of those who twisted@my teachings.
Twisted...?
Although my kin over there seems to have@had a different path.
It's looking at us...!
That thing's looking at us!
It's looking at us...!
Kin... So Fureim really was@a Kadum Hakam...!
So that's the true nature of our god,@the god of the Fury...
It doesn't have a clear will like XN-L@because it hasn't fully awakened...?
Throwing itself before those it was to teach,@aiding them... Unbecoming of a Hakam.@The height of folly.
Oh? Isn't the goal of the Kadum Hakam@to raise intelligent life strong enough@to overcome the great trial?
Besides, at first you said you'd dispose@of the aggregates of negative thought.
Your mighty strength and will invite new calamity.@That is surely why I was drawn here.
(Because Earth is a special place...?!)
For what purpose?
To exterminate the aggregates of negative thought,@of course... the aggregates of dark thought.
Then you're aiming at the wrong target!
Light begets darkness, and darkness begets light.@To sever that chain...
To fully exterminate the aggregates of negative@thought, one need only eradicate their source:@life-thought.
Hogwash! That's got it all backwards!
You're gonna wipe out us instead of@Dark Brain or the Lamaris?!
Where there is intelligent life, there is malice.@I shall cut off that which feeds the Kaimei Brain...@at its very root.

Silence.
That sounds just like...
That gourd-headed creep's talkin'@just like the <Einst> boss!
Could there be some kind of connection@between the Hakam and the Einst...?
Aren't you overthinking it?
But they do have a few things in common.
To think our deity ship...@the Grandred Fenossa, would try to destroy@the very ones it should protect...
There are countless intelligent life-forms in this@universe. Wiping out every one of them would be@terribly inefficient.
Maybe XN-L is broken.
Like Duminas...?

The Blade of the Imperial Family where a Kadum@Hakam dwells... the Granteed Dracodeus.
I see!
An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth...@and for a Kadum Hakam,@a Kadum Hakam.

So we wouldn't have to create an evil god@like <Volkruss>, right?

Scatter and perish alongside the fools@and the Kaimei Brain's servants.
Hmph... I'm a bad guy myself, but@I ain't never seen a bad guy like you.
So what about it?!
Listen, Roa.@I got plenty of grudges against that idiot too.@Let's call a truce for now.
...Fine.

That guy...!

Hmph, a last-ditch struggle!

Meanwhile, the Granteed Dracodeus's power@seems to be rising.
Yes, I can feel power welling up from within.
The creator god Fureim may be@awakening.
What could one who is little more than a soul@be drawing on...!

Josh...!

Our Super Soul Saber is one too!
Then shall we deliver the final blow to the ancient@giant who boasts of being a ruler?
Yeah, we'll settle this good and proper@so not a speck of grudge is left!
All units, concentrate fire on XN-L atop the deity@ship! We'll give it everything we have and bring it down!
Right!@Unleash, blade of steel! Like a raging fire!
XN-L! Together with Fureim,@I deny your existence!
We're your last opponents!@The Last Fighters!!
Cu-Curse you...!@Purify this world... my seeds...
N-Newly taught... life-forms...!
That... That...!@That you... are seeds of strength...!
I refuse... I refuse it...!@That you... could reach... the Taikyoku..........
XN-L has been annihilated!@No remaining enemy readings!
I-Is it finally over...?
No, not yet...!
Touya?!
Hmph... You mean me?
No, it's the Granteed Dracodeus...@Fureim is telling me.
That we can't leave the Gate of Voda...@the Cross Gate, standing...!
I heard it too, but sealing it...
I understand now what sealing really means.
S-surely not!?
It means making the Cross Gate disappear.
Are you serious?!
Yeah... We can do it, the way we are now.
But what if it fails?!
...With the Sympathia, we could only seal it.@But with the original Cytron System@and Fureim...
Not a key to close it,@but a sword to destroy it...?
But even my father never went that far!
The conditions are all in place, I suppose.@Give it a try, Touya Shiun.
H-Hey, Shu!
That's something that couldn't be@accomplished in La Gias, you know?
If the worst happens because of this,@are you gonna take responsibility?!
...Very well.
Wh-What?! What're you gonna do?!
It must mean he's that certain.@Touya, that's right, isn't it?
However, this is not something@he can accomplish on his own.
All of you must unite your feelings as one.
...Never thought I'd hear words like that from you.
W-Wait just a moment! Deciding something so vital@on the front line! This needs approval from the Joint@Chiefs of Staff... no, from the President!
Then we would miss our chance.@Surely you understand that Fureim's state@of awakening is the key.
Then stop at sealing it!
...It's a long-shot gamble, but I'm in.
Me too.
OK...@It'll mean one less way home, but I'm all in.
I'm... betting on it too.
(If the Cross Gate can be destroyed,@my concern would be...)
Does anyone object?
Shu Shirakawa! Damn you!!
Now then, Touya... please begin.
Understood.
With us and the Granteed Dracodeus...@and the power of everyone's feelings,@we can destroy the Cross Gate!
Let's do this, Katia! Shana-Mia!
Right!
Let's do this, Tenia! Shana-Mia!
Right!
Let's do this, Melua! Shana-Mia!
Right!
Understood. May Fureim protect you.
Katia, Busker Mode!
Right, activating!
Tenia, Busker Mode!
Roger! Activating!
Melua, Busker Mode!
Yes, activating!
Tou-Ya, this sword is our will...!
Yeah!
We'll destroy the Cross Gate here and end this!
So that we can move forward!!
Cross Gate! Gate of Voda!
Shatter and disappeaaaaar!!
Paris, Earth Federation Government: Presidential Office
Inside the Presidential Office
Daniel
...That is how the Cross Gate came to be@destroyed, Mr. President.
Harold
Marshal,@did you order its destruction?
Gaspar
No, it was decided in the field. Though I've received@reports that Shu Shirakawa, who was accompanying@the Steel Dragons, instigated it.
Mitsuko
My, my... Burying such a precious@subject of research...
Still, perhaps it was for the best in the end.@May we consider this conflict@to be over, then?
As long as the Lamaris don't reappear anywhere.
Then hurry and confirm the purification.
I'll dispatch the Steel Dragons at once.
...By the way, what do you intend to do@with Gaw-La Furia and@the Dark Iron Castle?
They are currently under our army's watch.@Both are lumps of <EOT>. We have no intention@of letting them go easily.
Oh my...@Won't you let our company have a piece of it?

If you're confident you can master the Fury's@technology, I'll allow it.
<Isurugi Heavy Industries> will devote itself@fully to the task.
Hold on.@I have an idea regarding what@to do with Gaw-La Furia.
Oh? What sort of thing?
That's...
Near Earth
Steel Dragons
Hagane - Commander's Office

Fureim's awakening seems to have been@a major factor in their success.
La Gias's Kadum Hakam and XN-L,@who bared their fangs at intelligent life...

For us, that means the future@has opened wide.
Indeed... If the Cross Gates themselves@can be eliminated...
Perhaps that is the destiny@we have been given.
By the way...@what state is Fureim in now?
According to Touya Shiun,@it has gone back to sleep.
Unlike La Gias's Kadum Hakam and XN-L,@it has no machine-god body... I imagine@it can't stay in an awakened state.
Will Fureim ever wake again...
And what will happen when it does...@Only whoever created the Cross Gates and sent@the Hakam into our world would know, I suppose.
Though whether such a being truly exists@is unknown.
So in the end... we never found out@what happened to Skull Knight after that, huh?
There ain't nobody left in@the Dark Iron Castle, right?
Yeah... According to the survey team's report,@that's right.
When the Granteed Dracodeus destroyed@the Cross Gate, everyone's thoughts surged out@in one great torrent...
Malice bodies like the Lamaris were erased,@and Skull Knight, a negative being himself,@may have met the same fate.
Still... who'd have thought he'd help us out@in the final battle?
That don't wipe the slate clean for@everything that creep did, but...
If he ever shows his face again,@I'll settle things with him good and proper.
In the end... the only Gadisword people left@are the three of us...
Our planet's gone too,@so I guess this is the end of Gadisword...
That's not true. Not as long as you're here.
That's right. You can just live on Earth.
But whether we'll be welcomed...
We've been together like this and made it through@some tough fights. I'm sure it'll be fine.
Yeah. A lot has happened, but... we're the proof@that Earthlings and Gadisword people@can get along.
Zovorg is also prepared to take you in as refugees.@In our world, people born on different planets@live together...
Either way, it's up to us to start@a new history for Gadisword, huh?
That's right... This whole thing showed us@that all sorts of civilizations exist.
Living alongside them is the path@we should take from now on.
So are you going to Zovorg, Fairy?
Once things settle down, I'd like to take@my time and talk it over with Sieg and Sally...
Hey, only if you want to, but...@why don't you all come to Mogami Heavy Industries?
Huh...?
You could work on our development team@as test pilots.@That's okay, right, Jinpu?
Jinpu
Whoa, whoa, springing that on me out of nowhere...
You're against it?
That ain't it, but...@there's applications and paperwork and all that.
So I'm talking about after all that's done.
If we can be with Akimi and Akemi and the others,@that might be nice. Right, big brother?
Yeah... I guess.
What about you, Fairy?
But wouldn't we be a bother...?
Of course not.@I'm asking you too, Jinpu.
Can't be helped... Guess I'll try talkin'@the president into it.
Then it's settled!
Thank you, Akimi...
Whaaat, seriously?!
We've got a mission now, of all times...
Can't be helped, can it?@Debudedabide went and set loose Lamaris@at the very last minute.
So just to be safe, we have to recheck@the purification everywhere ourselves.
Until that mission's done, the government can't declare@an end to this. The Special Tactics Instructor Unit will@also keep accompanying the Steel Dragons.
Kota and the others will also have to help us@investigate the Dark Iron Castle.
So we don't get a break either...
